strategies.title: Strategy Control
strategies.disposition: Phase 1 remains preserved with final result APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Phase 2 route 1, mean-reversion v2, remains terminally implementation-inconclusive with no economic result. Route 2, relative-value rotation v2, used its initial implementation and all three authorized pre-run repair rounds. A fresh live read-only Sol/xhigh audit independently confirmed its exact terminal classification as IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED_REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED / IMPLEMENTATION_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT. It is not unprofitable, HISTORICAL_NO_GO, or DATA_NO_GO; the strategy family was neither economically evaluated nor economically consumed, and no formal economic attempt or performance result exists. Passing controller tests, synthetic traces, and partial implementation evidence are not evidence of trading profitability. Route 3, volatility-managed equal-weight v2, is now queued for preregistration only and has not accessed market data. Every Phase 2 final holdout remains closed and unread, no candidate is promoted, capital remains zero, GPU permission remains zero, and Vertcoin mining is unchanged.
